customManagers.description: The composite actions set the Node.js version as an input default, which the github-actions manager doesn't read; look it up from the same source as setup-node in the workflows, so both move in one PR

packageRules.description: The Maven modules of Kompanion are built and used locally and never published, so there is nothing to look up

Wait two weeks before proposing an npm release, so broken or compromised releases are usually withdrawn by then. Yarn's npmMinimalAgeGate in .yarnrc.yml stays at one week: it also applies to security fixes and to packages added by hand, and must never be stricter than this, or Renovate would propose versions Yarn refuses
Match npmPreapprovedPackages in .yarnrc.yml, which Yarn exempts from the age gate

The tags of cypress/browsers carry the Node.js and browser versions (node-<node>-chrome-<chrome>-ff-<firefox>-edge-<edge>), which the docker versioning can't read. Order them by Node.js version, then Chrome major and build; stay on the Node.js major the CI uses
